admission_rule_exact: Let L be the frozen encoding_size and k the number of variable nodes in the canonical source-incidence 2-core. Admit iff 2^k <= L^2. Do not tune c after seeing results.
complexity_bound: At most L^2 core assignments; each branch performs polynomial simplification and exact linear-time incidence-forest message passing.
candidate_requirements: Reuse the same canonical source-incidence 2-core definition and exact residual forest solver from the sealed c=1 carrier.
No search for a minimum/optimal feedback set, backdoor, treewidth, separator, or best cut.
If 2^k > L^2, return OPEN before enumerating any core assignment.
Every SAT terminal must replay its witness on the untouched source CNF.
UNSAT is authorized only after all admitted core assignments are exhausted with exact residual UNSAT.
Keep the sealed c=1 carrier unchanged; implement c=2 as a new carrier.
Trinity v4 appends the new c=2 carrier as door 9 after the frozen eight-door v3 order; no prior door may be reordered or modified.
checker_requirements: Verify c=2 constant and exact integer branch guard 2^k <= L^2.
Verify a width-above-c2 control returns OPEN with enumerated_assignments=0.
Verify random small terminal decisions against bounded independent brute force.
Verify Trinity v4 preserves all prior v3 terminal decisions/doors and Captain tamper rollback.
Verify the four frozen remaining v3 OPEN cases without assuming they must close.
No universal completeness conclusion is authorized by finite closure.
